Hi MrBeast, I’m Katherine Verrone. I live in Uruguay, I’m 25 years old, and I have a passport. I’ve actually been watching your videos for four years, and I would love to participate in one—whether by competing or helping others. I’m currently unemployed and the sole provider for my household; all I want is to give my mother a home of our own so we can stop paying rent. We’ve survived as best we could for years, and—without blaming the government—we simply can't find a job that pays enough to cover rent and allow us to live with dignity. I trust in God; I know He will work the miracle to make this happen. Thank you so much, and God bless you.❤❤❤
